titulo: Running a generator in the garage with the door open?
receta: regla con número para guardar (20 pies) + error cotidiano de seguridad
destinatario: se lo manda quien vivió un apagón a su papá o vecino que enciende el generador en el garage con la puerta abierta
regla_guardable: Generator: outside only, at least 20 feet from the house. Never in the garage, even with the door open.

interaccion.guardar: Generator: outside only, at least 20 feet from the house. Never in the garage, even with the door open.
interaccion.comentar: Have you ever lost power for more than a day? How long?

fuentes: CPSC (Consumer Product Safety Commission), winter weather safety tips: never operate a portable generator inside a home, garage, basement, crawlspace, shed or other enclosed space; opening doors or windows will not provide enough ventilation to prevent lethal levels of carbon monoxide; operate outside only, at least 20 feet away from the house

frases.texto: The power's out, so you run the generator in the garage with the door open.
frases.estilo: Dry, direct, with a half smile.

frases.texto: The Consumer Product Safety Commission says an open door or window won't give you enough ventilation to stop carbon monoxide from building up to deadly levels.
You can't see it or smell it, so you won't know it's there.
Its rule is simple: generators go outside only, at least twenty feet from the house.
Not on the porch, and not in the carport. Those are too close.
Save this for the next big storm.
Have you ever lost power for more than a day? Tell me how long.
Send this to the friend who already owns a generator.
